champions.name: Ambessa
champions.tldr: New Effect: If an Attack command has been queued during an ability lockout and both 1) the player issues a Hold (default J) or Stop (default S) command and 2) the acquired target is within Ambessa's attack range after…
champions.gameplayImpact: Ambessa is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Voicelines that trigger from Mel}} are no longer missing their effect processing.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Non-unique-event voicelines that trigger from Mel}} no longer fail to play more lines than one per event.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: If an Attack command has been queued during an ability lockout and both 1) the player issues a Hold (default J) or Stop (default S) command and 2) the acquired target is within Ambessa's attack range after the end of the lockout, then Ambessa's dash will cancel.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hold/Stop commands will now also properly invalidate the acquisition if the target is not within attack range under these conditions.
